enonce.texte: Analyze the following sentences and identify the advanced grammar structure used: Present Perfect, Past Perfect, Future Perfect, Conditionals, or Reported Speech.

questions.reponse: 1. Present Perfect, 2. Past Perfect, 3. Third Conditional, 4. Reported Speech

sousQuestions.texte: I have lived in Cameroon for ten years.
She had already left when I arrived.
sousQuestions.reponse: Past Perfect (action before another past action).

sousQuestions.texte: If I had known, I would have helped.
He said that he was going to the market.

enonce.texte: Identify and correct the errors in the following sentences.

questions.reponse: 1. I have been studying English for five years. 2. If I were you, I would accept the offer. 3. She told me that she was tired.

sousQuestions.texte: I have studied English since five years.
sousQuestions.reponse: I have studied English for five years. (Use 'for' with duration).

sousQuestions.texte: If I was you, I will accept the offer.
sousQuestions.reponse: If I were you, I would accept the offer. (Second conditional: were + would).

sousQuestions.texte: She told me she is tired.
sousQuestions.reponse: She told me that she was tired. (Backshift in reported speech).

enonce.texte: Match the advanced vocabulary word with its definition.

sousQuestions.reponse: Showing a great variety of people or things
Able to be maintained at a certain rate or level
Able to recover quickly from difficulties

intitule: Competence: Using Language Accurately in All Contexts

enonce.texte: Write a paragraph (8-10 sentences) on the following topic: "The importance of learning English in today's world." Use at least three advanced grammar structures and five advanced vocabulary words.

questions.reponse: Example: English has become the global language of communication. I have studied English for many years (Present Perfect). If I hadn't learned English, I would have missed many opportunities (Third Conditional). The ability to speak English is extremely important for international business. It is also essential for accessing information online. Furthermore, English allows people to connect with others from diverse backgrounds. I believe that learning English is a sustainable investment in one's future. It makes individuals more resilient in the job market. In conclusion, English is a powerful tool for personal and professional growth.

enonce.texte:
Read the following text and find at least five errors. Correct them and explain each correction.

"I have been living in Douala for three years. If I had more money, I will travel more. She said she is happy with her new job. I have saw that movie already. He should of called me yesterday."

questions.reponse: 1. 'for three years' - Correct. 2. 'If I had more money, I would travel more.' (Second conditional). 3. 'She said she was happy.' (Backshift). 4. 'I have seen that movie already.' (Past participle of see). 5. 'He should have called me yesterday.' (Perfect modal).

enonce.texte: Complete the sentences with the correct tense: present, past, future, or a combination.

sousQuestions.texte: I ______ (work) on this project for two years now.
By the time you get here, I ______ (be) waiting for an hour.

intitule: Competence: Formal and Informal Language Use

enonce.texte:
Rewrite the following informal email in a formal tone. Use appropriate vocabulary and grammar.

"Hi John, I'm writing to tell you about the meeting. We need to talk about the budget. Let me know when you're free. Cheers, Peter"

questions.reponse: Example: "Dear John, I am writing to inform you about the upcoming meeting. We need to discuss the budget. Could you please let me know your availability? I look forward to your response. Yours sincerely, Peter"

enonce.texte: Write a self-assessment of your English skills in grammar, vocabulary, and communication. Identify your strengths and areas for improvement. Then, write a 3-step action plan to improve in the next three months.

questions.texte: Write the self-assessment and action plan.
questions.reponse: Example: Self-Assessment: I am confident in using present and past tenses. However, I need to improve my use of conditionals and phrasal verbs. My vocabulary is good, but I need to learn more idiomatic expressions. In communication, I can express myself clearly, but I need to work on my pronunciation. Action Plan: 1) Practice conditionals daily for 10 minutes. 2) Learn 5 new phrasal verbs each week. 3) Listen to English podcasts for 15 minutes every day to improve listening and pronunciation.

enonce.texte: You are preparing for a B2/C1 level exam. Write an essay (200-250 words) on the following topic: "Technology has improved the quality of life in Cameroon." Agree or disagree, using advanced grammar and vocabulary.

questions.reponse: Example: Technology has undoubtedly improved the quality of life in Cameroon, although it has also created new challenges. Firstly, access to the internet has revolutionized communication. If people had not had smartphones, they would not have been able to connect easily (Third Conditional). Furthermore, technology has improved healthcare. For instance, telemedicine allows doctors to reach remote areas. However, technology has also increased inequality. Nevertheless, I believe that the benefits outweigh the drawbacks. In conclusion, technology has been a powerful driver of progress, and if used wisely, it will continue to improve lives (First Conditional).
